title: French-Style Braised Lentils
subtitle: with Avocado and Tomato Salsa
description: There's lots to know about the lentil - it's lean, it's nutritious and it's full of fibre to start with. But the main takeaway here is it tastes darned good, especially with avo, cherry tomatoes and a hint of smoked paprika.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Halve or quarter the tomatoes. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Rinse and drain the lentils. Pick the coriander leaves and finely chop the stems.

Start cooking: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic, three-quarters of the onion and 1½ tsp smoked paprika (the remaining paprika won't be used in this dish), season with salt and pepper and cook, stirring, for 3 mins or until soft.

Braise lentils: Stir in the lentils and 750ml (3 cups) boiling water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 10 mins. Stir in the coriander stems and half the tomatoes and cook, for a further 15 mins or until the lentils are tender and the liquid has reduced.

Pickle onion: Meanwhile, combine the remaining onion, 1 tbs red wine vinegar, a pinch of salt and ¼ tsp sugar in a large bowl and stand for 10 mins to pickle. Cut the avocado into 1-2cm chunks, discarding the skin and stone.

Serve up: Add the avocado, coriander leaves and remaining tomatoes to the pickled onion, season with salt and pepper and gently toss to combine. Divide the braised lentils among bowls and top with the avocado salsa to serve.
Make it yours: Serve each bowl of lentils topped with a dollop of Greek-style yoghurt for a creamy, cooling finish.
